questions.question: What does chapter 15 address?
options: The yearly appointed feasts of the LORD

questions.question: How did a person generally become clean again after becoming unclean?
options: By traveling far outside the camp for a whole month
By offering a piece of gold to the priest
By fasting in private for seven days
By washing with water and waiting until evening
questions.answer: By washing with water and waiting until evening
